carried.description: the ids this round closed by carrying them into the next round of its instrument. Real, unfixed, on a re-rated severity — minor or nit, or any severity once the round has spent its pass budget — and re-banked next time.

schema_version.description: the tool MAJOR this artefact was written under

code.description: the exit code of the round's last docs build — by `prepare`, `pass open` or `gbg round build <round>`; 0 is the only value `close` accepts

head.description: the HEAD it ran at, so a build older than the round's last code change is not read as a current one

at.description: when it ran, for the reader of a closed round

build.description: the last docs build this round ran — by `prepare`, `pass open` or `gbg round build`, recorded only over a tree whose covered paths are unmodified. Nothing recorded a build's verdict before 2026-09-12, so a round could carry a RED build through graded passes and close on it: `prepare` built green at open, a fix pass's prose edits moved SCAN.PROSE_SHAPE's ratchet, and nothing looked at a build again.

head.description: the HEAD the scripts were re-copied from

reason.description: why the frozen scripts could not serve the round

after_pass.description: the passes the round had opened when the scripts moved: passes up to it ran on the old scripts

scripts.description: every script replaced, with the sha256 of the frozen copy (or `absent`) and of its replacement

by_hand.description: true when the frozen copy no longer matched the sha preflight recorded: it had been altered outside this verb

scripts_refreshed.description: each time `gbg round scripts <round> --reason` replaced frozen verifier or auditor scripts of this round. The scripts are frozen when the round opens (RULE.INST.FROZEN_MIDROUND); the verb is the one exception, for a round whose own verifiers or auditors cannot run (2026-09-12-check-docs-01 found its verifiers unparseable), and it never touches a lens script. Every refresh is appended with why, when, after how many passes, and which scripts with their shas, so a reader of the closed round sees that the passes around it ran on different scripts. Only `at` and `head` are required, the shape the verb wrote before it recorded more.

seed_skipped.description: the seed classes this round could not plant, their anchor absent from its corpus: each is UNDEFINED in recall. Written at prepare and repeated by grade, so a narrowed measurement is never a silent one.

seed_root.description: the disposable corpus a seeded documentation round's lanes read: the lane surfaces copied outside the repository and mutated. Written at prepare, destroyed at bank; the repository itself is never seeded.

script_shas.description: script name → sha256 of the frozen copy preflight wrote into the round's workflow directory, updated by `gbg round scripts` for what it replaces: a copy that no longer matches was altered outside the verbs, and the next refresh records it as such.
